title: Skunk Works advisors to Secret Machines

tellings.quote: Other senior Skunk Works figures, Robert Weiss, Steve Justice, and Eric Schrock, along with Air Force Research Lab Commander Neil McCaslin, all advised Tom DeLonge and Peter Levenda's Secret Machines project.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that senior figures from Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design division of the defence company Lockheed, named Robert Weiss, Steve Justice and Eric Schrock, advised a project called Secret Machines from around 2016. He says Neil McCaslin, a commander at the Air Force Research Laboratory, also advised it, and that the project was run by the musician Tom DeLonge and the writer Peter Levenda, which would mean insiders from secret aerospace work backed a public UFO effort.
